C1044.title: BYOD Security Challenges, Solutions, and Policy Best Practices: A Review
C1044.summary: This study reviews security challenges in BYOD environments, noting that employees using personal devices to access organizational networks and resources introduces security risks. It emphasizes the need for organizations to develop effective security policies and technical controls to manage these risks and proposes a comprehensive security policy model.

references.title: A review of BYOD security challenges, solutions and policy best practices
